sentences.en: Ken is a boy.
Today is a day off.
Ken leaves the house.
The flowers in town are red.
Ken looks at the flowers.

sentences.ja: けんは花の下で休みます。
sentences.en: Ken rests under the flowers.

sentences.ja: けんは小さい店に入ります。
sentences.en: Ken goes into a small shop.

sentences.ja: 店の中で肉を食べます。
sentences.en: He eats meat in the shop.
Ken drinks some water too.
The meat is one thousand yen.
The person at the shop is a man.

sentences.ja: けんは「ありがとう」と言います。
sentences.en: Ken says thank you.

sentences.ja: けんは海まで歩きます。
sentences.en: Ken walks as far as the sea.
The sea is wide.
The sky is blue.

sentences.ja: 海の右に車があります。
sentences.en: There is a car to the right of the sea.
Ken looks at the car.
The sun goes down below the sea.
Ken comes home.

sentences.ja: 家の中に本があります。
sentences.en: There is a book in the house.

sentences.ja: 本に友人の名があります。
sentences.en: A friend's name is in the book.
Ken looks at the book.
Ken thinks for a little while.

sentences.ja: けんの休日はいいです。
sentences.en: Ken's day off is a good one.
